snapshot.name: Packrift Guide-to-SKU Evidence Agent Gateway

endpoints.description: Fetch guide-to-SKU gateway counts and source boundaries.
endpoints.response_description: Public JSON stats for represented guides, represented SKUs, edge counts, guide coverage bands, product-family rollups, product-type rollups, and source asset URLs.

endpoints.description: Fetch sample public Packrift guide-to-SKU rows.
endpoints.response_description: Public-safe sample rows with guide title, guide URL, SKU, product URL, family, product type, and full-atlas evidence URL.

endpoints.description: Fetch top public Packrift guide coverage rollups.
endpoints.response_description: Public guide rollups with guide handles, guide URLs, represented SKU counts, and gateway guide URLs.

endpoints.description: Fetch top public Packrift SKU guide coverage rollups.
endpoints.response_description: Public SKU rollups with SKU, product URL, guide coverage counts, and gateway SKU URLs.

endpoints.description: Enumerate Guide-to-SKU Evidence Gateway crawlable URLs.
endpoints.response_description: XML sitemap containing gateway home, manifest, OpenAPI, data, methodology, guide rollup, SKU rollup, guide, and SKU URLs.

snapshot.agent_notes: Read-only public gateway. No account, login, API key, private credential, payment, or 2FA is required. Pricing for this reference corpus is free. Public guide coverage evidence only; check the live Packrift guide or product page before purchase. This is not guide-body republication, live checkout, shipping quote, delivery promise, inventory promise, endorsement claim, vendor financial disclosure, margin report, customer/order/cart/payment system, private source path, private freight source, or live availability claim.
snapshot.description: A compact no-auth Packrift gateway for guide-to-SKU evidence, guide coverage, and SKU coverage rollups.
